answer: Splitting into 8 separate vaults needs a separate funded garden account and a separate escrow deposit for each, which means the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence as the dawn binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The reef explorer shows the whole merge tree. A 140 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
